data.name: Enhanced Defense
data.description: Infuses armor or a shield with a defensive bonus; the bonus improves at higher Artificer level.
manual_effects: Apply the AC modifier while the infused item is in use.

data.name: Enhanced Weapon
data.description: Improves a simple or martial weapon's attack and damage bonus, scaling at higher Artificer level.
manual_effects: Apply the attack and damage modifiers when using the infused weapon.

data.name: Enhanced Arcane Focus
data.description: Improves spell attacks made through an arcane focus and supports its cover-ignoring rider manually.
manual_effects: Resolve cover interaction manually; M01-H does not automate spell attack targeting.

data.name: Returning Weapon
data.description: Improves a thrown weapon and causes it to return after a ranged attack.
manual_effects: Return-to-hand behavior is descriptive in M01-H.

data.name: Repeating Shot
data.description: Improves an ammunition weapon and supplies its ammunition while the infusion is active.
manual_effects: Ammunition generation and loading-property interaction are manual in M01-H.

data.name: Mind Sharpener
data.description: Stores charges that can be spent to support concentration after a failed concentration check.
manual_effects: Robes are also eligible by the source rule; equipment lacking an armor classification requires manual eligibility confirmation.

data.name: Homunculus Servant
data.description: Uses an eligible gem or crystal as the heart of a homunculus servant.
manual_effects: The homunculus is not created as a combat entity in M01-H; its stat block remains metadata/manual play.

data.name: Armor of Magical Strength
data.description: Stores charges for Strength-related benefits and resisting being knocked prone.
manual_effects: Charge spending and roll modification are manual in M01-H.

name: Replicate Magic Item: Bag of Holding

data.name: Replicate Magic Item: Bag of Holding
data.description: A concrete Replicate Magic Item recipe. The known recipe remains an infusion identity while the active target is an inventory item instance.
manual_effects: Full magic-item behavior remains deferred; M01-H tracks verified identity and active state only.

data.name: Boots of the Winding Path
data.description: Infuses boots with a short-range return-to-a-recent-space movement option.
manual_effects: Movement history and teleport resolution are manual in M01-H.

data.name: Radiant Weapon
data.description: Improves a weapon, can shed light, and stores charges for a reactive blinding effect.
manual_effects: Light toggling and reaction/save resolution are manual in M01-H.

data.name: Repulsion Shield
data.description: Improves a shield and stores charges for a reactive push effect.
manual_effects: Reaction and forced-movement resolution are manual in M01-H.

data.name: Resistant Armor
data.description: Grants a selected damage resistance while the infused armor is worn.
manual_effects: The resistance type is chosen and applied manually in M01-H.

data.name: Spell-Refueling Ring
data.description: Allows the wearer to recover a spent spell slot within the feature's supported range.
manual_effects: Choosing and restoring the spell slot is manual in M01-H.

data.name: Helm of Awareness
data.description: Provides awareness benefits while worn and attuned.
manual_effects: Initiative advantage and surprise handling are manual until combat automation exists.

data.name: Arcane Propulsion Armor
data.description: Enhances a suit of armor with mobility and gauntlet weapon benefits.
manual_effects: Movement and gauntlet attack effects remain manual in M01-H.
